segments.name: Products and Solutions
products: smoke and carbon monoxide detection home safety products
segments.description: Makes and sells branded comfort, energy management, safety and security products such as thermostats, smoke alarms, cameras and water solutions.
segments.evidence: Our products and solutions for comfort, energy management, safety, and security benefit from trusted, well-established branded offerings such as Braukmann, BRK, First Alert, Honeywell Home, Resideo, and others.

segments.name: ADI Global Distribution
segments.description: Distributes professionally installed low-voltage products, including security and audio-visual solutions, to licensed installers, dealers and integrators.
segments.evidence: Our ADI Global Distribution segment is a leading, global specialty distributor of professionally installed low-voltage products, including security and audio-visual ("AV") solutions, serving commercial and residential markets through an omnichannel go-to-market platform.

revenueModel.text: Homeowners, businesses, professional installers and dealers pay Resideo for comfort, safety and security products and for distributed low-voltage products.
revenueModel.evidence: ADI Global Distribution sells primarily to licensed professional installers, dealers, and integrators.

changes.text: In 2025 Resideo announced its intention to separate the ADI Global Distribution segment through a tax-free spin-off.
changes.evidence: On July 30, 2025, we announced our intention to separate the ADI Global Distribution segment through a tax-free spin-off to our shareholders
